stories.title: Twenty cases of two reasons, decided by group, then one undone
stories.recipe: ten unreferenced payments each paid by the bank within the window, and ten referenced deposits credited five days after the receipt; both groups accepted; then one suggestion undone

stories.title: Exceptions come first, whatever their amounts, each by its impact
stories.recipe: small exceptions of every kind: 600.00 received as 599.50 (impact 600.00), a 450.00 card settlement booked as a receipt (450.00), a 200.00 cheque paid twice (400.00 on the statement side), 300.00 paid as 310.00 (310.00), two 150.00 withdrawals for one 150.00 entry (300.00); and three large suggestions; no decision

stories.title: Equal impact: the group with more members first, then case number
stories.recipe: unreferenced payments of 2,500.00 on the 4th and the 21st and of 1,000.00 on the 12th, each with its entry, and an unreferenced deposit of 2,500.00 with its receipt: the cases of 2,500.00 come first, in case number order, then the case of 1,000.00 numbered between them

stories.title: Suggestions in both directions are two groups
stories.recipe: three unreferenced deposits and three unreferenced withdrawals, each with its entry; the deposits accepted as a group

stories.title: Date gaps of five and nine days are two groups
stories.recipe: two cheques paid five days after the book and one nine days after; the five-day group accepted

stories.title: Amount differences rejected as a group stay listed by case
stories.recipe: three supplier transfers paid by the bank for less than the book records under the same reference; rejected as a group

stories.title: A case decided on its own is left out of the group decision
stories.recipe: four unreferenced deposits; the accountant rejects one, then accepts the group

stories.title: A corrected cashbook after a group decision refuses the session
stories.recipe: three unreferenced payments accepted as a group; then the cashbook is replaced by a corrected copy with one more cheque

stories.title: Amount differences in each direction: rejecting one group leaves the other
stories.recipe: two payments and two receipts with amount differences under their references; the payments rejected as a group

stories.title: An Arabic statement: suggestions accepted as a group
stories.recipe: as Q07 with five payments, printed in Arabic with Arabic-Indic digits; accepted as a group

stories.title: Sixty suggestions in two groups
stories.recipe: forty unreferenced payments and twenty unreferenced deposits, each with its entry, over several pages; both groups accepted

stories.title: A held statement has no queue
stories.recipe: three suggestions planted, but the third printed balance is 10.00 off the chain

stories.title: Nothing to decide
stories.recipe: six movements recorded on both sides under their references

stories.title: One reference repeated on either side: two shapes, two groups
stories.recipe: two cheques each paid twice by the bank, and one cheque recorded twice in the book

stories.title: Undo two, then decide the group again
stories.recipe: five unreferenced deposits accepted as a group; two undone; the group, now those two, rejected

stories.title: A small exception before a large suggestion
stories.recipe: a 12.00 transfer the book records as 12.10 under its reference, and a 98,500.00 unreferenced payment with its entry
